summary.text:
Supporting Students and Families Act
This bill establishes a nonrefundable federal income tax credit of up to $200 for eligible elementary and secondary school supply expenses. (Limits apply.)
The bill defines eligible elementary and secondary school supply expenses as expenses for books, supplies, and other equipment paid in connection with the enrollment or attendance of a dependent at a public, private, or religious school.
The tax credit is reduced for taxpayers with a modified adjusted gross (MAGI) income exceeding $150,000, and no tax credit is allowed once a taxpayer’s MAGI equals $215,000.
